name: Ciletuh Geopark Run 2027
short_description: A half-marathon held at Pantai Palangpang, Sukabumi, Indonesia on January 17, 2027, offering 21.1 km, 10 km, and 5 km distances.
ai_summary: The Ciletuh Geopark Run 2027 is a half-marathon event scheduled for January 17, 2027, in Sukabumi, Jawa Barat, Indonesia. Organized by Indonesia's Ministry of Tourism as part of the 'Geopark Run Series,' the race takes place at Pantai Palangpang and offers three distance options: 21.1 km, 10 km, and 5 km. Registration details have not yet been announced.
